stem: A photoperiod crop is near a bright security light that runs through the night. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: Treat artificial night lighting as a possible photoperiod variable and evaluate exposure before assuming genetics alone explains flowering behavior
Assume outdoor crops cannot be affected by artificial light
Switch to more frequent irrigation to correct flowering timing
Ignore the light because only daytime intensity matters
rationale: Photoperiodic development depends on light/dark timing, so unintended night interruption can become a relevant environmental variable.
